name: Brunton Boatyard (CGH Earth)
summary: Brunton Boatyard is a CGH Earth hotel on Kochi harbour in Fort Kochi, built on the site of a 19th-century shipbuilding yard. Ayurveda treatments are offered in-house, and the old town's streets start at the door.
highlights: On the site of a 19th-century shipbuilding yard on Kochi harbour
Walking distance of Fort Kochi's heritage streets; cruises from the hotel's own jetty
Run by CGH Earth, a Kerala hotel group
